subject: Vendor onboarding + payment schedule request — BluePeak Systems
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: BluePeak Systems AP <ap@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: New supplier onboarding — payment cadence question

Hi Samantha / BluePeak AP team,

Thanks for completing the onboarding packet — we have everything except a couple of payment fields. BluePeak indicated Net 60 on the form, but Finance has requested we evaluate a shorter initial term to align with our standard ramp for new strategic suppliers. Would you consider the following?

- Initial onboarding period: Net 45 for the first 90 days
- Early-pay option: 2% if paid within 10 days (applies during first 90 days)
- After 90 days: transition to Net 60 (as requested)

The goal is to reduce payment friction while we get invoicing and PO automation aligned. If you can confirm acceptance, Laura will issue the PO and we can send the DocuSign link for the updated vendor agreement.

Attachments: BluePeak_onboarding_form.pdf (completed form)

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@bluepeak.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: BluePeak Systems AP <ap@bluepeak.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-14T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New supplier onboarding — payment cadence question

Hi Aditya —

Appreciate the note. We can be flexible for the onboarding window. A couple quick clarifications:

1) The 2% 10-day early pay: we can offer that, but it must be applied at invoice level (we use automatic adjustment in our ERP).
2) Net 45 for 90 days is acceptable, provided we receive a PO that references the onboarding terms and the signed vendor agreement.

I'll attach our W-9 and a signed supplier addendum once I have the PO number. Also sending a DocuSign for your legal to review — I included a link below.

Thanks,
Samantha Ortiz
Director, Finance Operations
BluePeak Systems
Attachment: BluePeak_W9.pdf (pdf)
Related link: https://app.docusign.com/abcd-BluePeak-Onboarding
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-15T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New supplier onboarding — payment cadence question

Aditya —

Thanks for looping me in. Sounds reasonable. Next steps from Finance (AP) side:

- I will create PO_6721 with Net 45 terms and a note: "Onboarding term: Net 45 for 90 days; 2%/10 early pay applies during onboarding period."
- We need the vendor to sign the addendum (Samantha indicated she'll send DocuSign).
- Please confirm billing email and remit-to details on the onboarding form so we match invoice routing.

Once signed, I'll route the PO to BluePeak and confirm expected payment run dates. If BluePeak requests Net 60 permanently after 90 days, we can build that into the supplier record and update payment terms then.

Laura Bennett
Manager, Accounts Payable
Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@bluepeak.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-16T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: DocuSign — BluePeak onboarding addendum

Forwarded message:
From: BluePeak Legal <legal@bluepeak.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-16T10:40:00-07:00
Subject: BluePeak onboarding addendum

Laura,

I've created the DocuSign packet with the onboarding addendum that includes the Net 45 (90-day) and the 2%/10 early pay option. Please review and sign. Once complete, we'll return the signed copy and upload to the vendor portal.

DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/abcd-BluePeak-Onboarding

Best,
BluePeak Legal
Attachment: BluePeak_signed_addendum_draft.pdf

Samantha (for BluePeak)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@bluepeak.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-18T15:28:00-07:00
Subject: RE: DocuSign — BluePeak onboarding addendum

Hi Samantha —

I signed the DocuSign packet and created PO_6721 this morning. Summary of execution:

- PO_6721 issued to BluePeak Systems; references onboarding term: Net 45 for first 90 days, 2%/10 early-pay option included.
- Signed addendum received (DocuSign) and stored in the supplier record.
- PO and supplier record updated with BluePeak remit: ap@bluepeak.com, ACH details on file.

Attachments: PO_6721_redwood.pdf (pdf)

Aditya — we will follow Redwood's standard payment runs. For onboarding invoices, expect first payment to hit Net 45 from invoice date (unless BluePeak applies early-pay). If you'd like, I can put a calendar reminder to reassess terms at the 75-day mark so we can transition to Net 60 automatically on day 91.

Thanks everyone — welcome aboard, BluePeak.

Laura Bennett
Manager, Accounts Payable
Redwood Inference
